say: In 1932, Australia declared war, on birds.
show: In 1932, Australia declared war… on BIRDS.

say: About twenty thousand emus were destroying wheat farms.
show: About 20,000 emus were destroying wheat farms.

say: So the army sent in soldiers, with two machine guns.
The emus split into tiny groups, and sprinted off at thirty miles an hour.
show: The emus split into tiny groups, and sprinted off at 30 mph.

say: So they mounted a gun on a truck.
The ride was so bumpy, the gunner couldn't fire a single shot.
After weeks of fighting, and nearly ten thousand bullets, the army packed up and went home.
show: After weeks of fighting, and nearly 10,000 bullets, the army packed up and went home.

say: History calls it, the Great Emu War.
show: History calls it… the Great Emu War.
